##### Project general facts

Al Zorah Beach Hills Villa's is a secure, gated beachfront neighbourhood of four-bedroom villas designed for a barefoot luxury lifestyle. The collection includes single-level simplex villas set on the second and third rows and duplex villas on the fourth row, each oriented to enjoy sea views. Every home sits on an extensive plot with ample gardens, a private pool and a secluded internal landscaped courtyard, while planted verges and pedestrian-friendly roads give the community a lush, resort-style character.

Residents enjoy direct access to a private white sandy beach and a wide range of community leisure and wellness facilities. A championship golf course, a wellness resort, a five-star beach resort, water sports facilities and a long cycling and running track are all part of the surrounding destination. Swimming pools, a gym and landscaped gardens add everyday comfort, while the protected natural mangrove forest offers a calm setting for walks and outdoor discovery.

Interiors are ultra-modern and multi-functional, blending seamlessly with the outdoor areas. Open-plan layouts allow dining areas to join the living room or close off for privacy, and generous kitchens become places for family gatherings. Duplex villas add a first-floor game room with sea views, while master suites feature a secluded seating area and private terrace. Blind elevations balance openness and privacy, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Zorah City is an award-winning mixed-use coastal destination in Ajman, stretching along an extensive waterfront with a white sandy beach, an inland creek and one of the oldest protected mangrove forests in the UAE. The community combines resorts, residences, wellness and leisure facilities, with landscaped green spaces and meandering pathways throughout. Its calm waters are ideal for swimming, diving and snorkelling for most of the year.

The Nicklaus Design championship golf course, The Oberoi Beach Resort and the Zoya Health and Wellbeing Resort sit within the community, alongside marinas and a golf and yacht clubhouse. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai, Sharjah International Airport and Dubai International Airport, while Ajman City Centre, schools, universities and hospitals are a short drive away. The community is also accessible by boat through its marinas.

Al Zorah City is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most distinctive coastal communities in the northern emirates. Beachfront villas with private pools are in limited supply, supporting demand from families and holiday home buyers. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, combined with a mature resort lifestyle offer, underpin long-term value and resilient resale prospects.
